suggested_fix: Run audio stop/player close and WebSocket close/queue erasure in nested try/finally blocks so every cleanup stage runs even if the sound device fails; propagate the original audio error after cleanup. Add a fake-player stop failure regression asserting socket closure and sensitive buffer clearing.
title: Audio stop failure prevents cloud session cleanup
why_it_matters: When the board output device fails while stopping, close exits before closing the WebSocket or clearing queued microphone data and tool results. ConversationPaths._stop has already removed the session reference, and closed=True suppresses later cleanup attempts, leaving the cloud connection unclosed and aborting route switching/privacy/shutdown cleanup.
